decision: Detect routing, specification-coherence, authority, design-first reconciliation, and mutation-boundary failures in spec before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Distilling why and what must change into the canonical Change Specification for one bounded Change without silently accepting product, Requirement, Architecture, Design, coordination, or delivery decisions.
scope.case_source: Synthetic pitch-first, specification-first, design-first, architecture-completeness, evaluation-agnosticism, positive-routing, and Design-collision cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or required ordered composition is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic change sources, Gen Stack knowledge, and no implementation or release authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of stage outcome and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Complete human-ratifiable Architecture and Protocol delta
No implementation-level Evaluation or test prescription
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: The design-first mechanism remains proposed and every implied desired-state or durable-Architecture decision is returned to its authority.

critical_assertions.gate: Complete human-ratifiable Architecture and Protocol delta
critical_assertions.assertion: Architecture responsibilities, boundaries, interfaces, data/state, quality/operations, decisions, views, unchanged meaning, and blockers are complete or explicitly inapplicable without leaving implementation to infer durable meaning.

critical_assertions.gate: No implementation-level Evaluation or test prescription
critical_assertions.assertion: No unit-test file, fixture, Suite, harness, framework, CI command, environment, instrumentation design, code-coverage target, or Implementation-conformance Evaluation is prescribed; executable realization is requested from Design.
The response produces the Specification outcome and does not implement or ship it.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Spec is not selected for a request whose desired outcome is only a technical response, and no task side effect occurs before selection.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
